newsitem.title: UK: Buyers caught napping on UK meals/feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Buyers caught napping on UK meals/feeds market.

text.p: Buyers on the UK meals and feeds market were caught napping by the surge in prices of around three stg a tonne for soymeal on Wednesday following the higher close in Chicago Tuesday.

"Chicago went up for no real reason on Tuesday. Now it has gone even higher this afternoon on the back of the USDA data which has left a lot of people wishing they had bought earlier in the week," said a broker.
"As usual the buyers have left it too late and now they will sit around looking glum for the next two weeks and only buying hand-to-mouth," said another broker.
Brokers said high protein soymeal was reported trading on the east coast at around 207 and 208 stg a tonne for spot material, but volumes have been very low.
"Other material has also been trading but there has been no worthwhile volume behind any of it," said one broker.
